brief:
Former Irish President Mary Robinson, speaking for The Elders, accused Israel of attempting to erase Palestine physically, economically, culturally and politically, Al Jazeera English reported. Robinson stated that Israel is "trying to make Palestine disappear" through systematic action affecting multiple dimensions of Palestinian life and governance.

The Elders, an independent group of former world leaders, characterized the situation as a comprehensive campaign targeting Palestinian existence and sovereignty. The organization's assessment reflects concerns about Israeli policies and actions in Palestinian territories, spanning military, economic, and administrative spheres.
dek: Former Irish President Mary Robinson: Israel ‘erasing Palestine physically, economically, culturally and politically’.
title: Israel erasing Palestine across all sectors, Elders group says
